subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw accept for channel group config entries?
rationale: This changes the public configuration contract, and repository policy favors one current canonical config shape instead of aliases or per-channel drift.

options.title: Adopt `name` across group entries
options.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, docs, generated metadata, and tests while keeping it runtime-ignored.

options.title: Choose another canonical field
options.body: Use one different field such as `label` or `description`, but still apply it consistently across the same config surfaces.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group entries behavior-only and leave readability to external notes, docs, or channel-provided display labels.

recommendation.title: Adopt `name` across group entries
recommendation.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, docs, generated metadata, and tests while keeping it runtime-ignored.

likelyOwner.reason: The central schema, docs, and prior review history make steipete the clearest owner for the config-contract choice.
